about: What a plain USDC or USDT transfer costs on each chain: the median fee of real transfers read from the chain through free public endpoints, in US dollars at the hour they were read. Where some senders pay nothing (prepaid energy, gasless or sponsored transfers) the figure is what a sender paying its own fee pays; paidLess says who paid less.
prices: each chain's price block names its on-chain source; none is published where the page shows a market-data price

chains.basis: What a sender pays when the transfer is charged gas. Since 20 May 2026 Sui runs eligible USDC transfers between address balances with no gas at all (gas price 0, no gas coin): the sender pays nothing and nobody pays in its place. 18 of the 30 plain transfers this hour went that way; the other 12 paid ordinary gas, 0.0001 SUI each.

estimate.basis: Not a measured USDT transfer: USDT cannot be seen on Liquid. This is what transactions with the shape of a wallet's USDT send paid — two or more inputs, three blinded outputs (payment, coin change, L-BTC change) and the fee. Liquid's fee depends on size, not on the asset, so a USDT send of that shape pays the same.
